jobs.title: Product Manager / Business Analyst - Digital & AI
jobs.description:
Debound · Delhi NCR

You will sit between the engineering teams building our digital platforms and the project directors, client organisations and site teams who use them. Your job is to turn how infrastructure delivery actually works into specifications an engineering team can build against, and to keep what gets built honest to what was asked for.

What you'll own

Requirement gathering across a difficult stakeholder set. Project directors, resident engineers, client organisations and site teams each describe the same process differently. You will run the discovery, resolve the contradictions, and write the version everyone signs off on.

Specifications and acceptance criteria. Written clearly enough that an engineer can build from them and a reviewer can test against them.

Code and delivery review. Not as the approving engineer, but as the person who checks that what shipped matches what was specified, and who catches the edge cases nobody raised in the requirements session.

Feasibility judgement on AI features. Deciding what is genuinely deliverable, what is a demo dressed as a product, and how to phase the difference.

Translation in both directions. Explaining engineering constraints to non-technical stakeholders, and site realities to engineers who have never been to a project site.
requirements: Requirements and elicitation experience. Evidence of specs you have written, acceptance criteria you have defined, and scope you have held. We are more interested in ambiguity you resolved than in features you listed.

A technical foundation strong enough to read code. A computer science degree, or several years shipping software before moving into product or analysis. You will not write production code, but you will read pull requests and judge whether an implementation matches its spec.
Written and spoken communication of a high standard. You will produce documents that go to senior stakeholders and to client organisations. Send us something you have written.
Working literacy in AI and agentic systems. Enough to challenge an estimate, evaluate a vendor claim, and understand why a demo that works on ten documents may not work on ten thousand.
Comfort with complex, regulated delivery environments. Structured processes, audit requirements and documentation standards should feel normal rather than obstructive.
Signals that would move you to the top of the list
Infrastructure, construction, EPC or PMC domain exposure — highways, bridges, railways, urban development, power, or water.
Experience with government or multilateral clients, and with the documentation and approval cycles they require.
Having worked on project monitoring, ERP, GIS or field-data-collection platforms.
Any hands-on work with LLM tooling, workflow automation, or data pipelines, however small.
Familiarity with BIM, DPR workflows, or construction supervision processes.
What this role is not

High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

What you’ll work on

Build agents that get compliance work done. Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

Make agent behavior measurable and reliable. Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios
requirements: At least two years of product management experience, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.

Hands-on experience with AI evaluations. You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.

Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex. These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.

Strong judgment about agentic user experiences. You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence. You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.

Strong ownership and organizational skills. You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
A willingness to get into the details. You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel. You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.

Curiosity and rigor in complex domains. You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

jobs.title: Product Manager — Travel & Hospitality Tech
jobs.description:
PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL | FINKRAFT.AI

Location: Bengaluru, HSR | Full-time | Level: L4 | Reports to: CPO / BU Head

ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI

Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.

The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it.

THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING

A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived.

This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN 90 DAYS

Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's
responsibilities: Product Strategy and Roadmap
Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why
Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions
Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence
Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped
Field Ecosystem Engagement

Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP)
Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability
Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs
Ecosystem Integration Ownership
Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS → GDS/OTA/TMC → Concur/expense tool → bank/payment → Finkraft → GST claim
Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff
requirements: 4–6 years in product management in travel, hospitality, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS
Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews
Working knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems: TMCs, GDS platforms, OTAs, PMS providers, and how they connect
Has shipped a B2B product that integrates with at least two external systems — understands what "integration complexity" actually means in production
Has written PRDs that engineering shipped from without PM hand-holding in every stand-up
Comfort with field-heavy, travel-intensive work across India
Strong Preference
Has worked directly with Concur, SAP Concur integrations, or competing expense management platforms
Exposure to bank lodge card programs, virtual card reconciliation, or payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, HDFC, Mastercard)
Prior exposure to GST, e-invoicing, or indirect tax reconciliation
Has integrated with or mapped data flows from Opera Cloud, Amadeus, Sabre, or equivalent hotel/GDS platforms
Experience at a TMC, GDS, OTA, hotel chain, or hotel software company is a significant advantage

jobs.description:
The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, design, and delivery of products within the Private Funds domain of the Clearwater system. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from defining the product and planning development through production and go-to-market. You will build the product roadmap needed to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets for your component.

This is a technical product role. You will work with engineering on data models, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, and you will be a domain authority on how private funds are structured, reported, and valued. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new capabilities, partner with development teams to build and launch them, and pilot new features with clients before promoting them to the wider client base.
responsibilities: Team Leadership: Lead and guide a team of 8-15 developers, supporting knowledge-sharing and training to build team effectiveness.
Product Ownership: Own the Private Funds product(s) end to end, from ideation through market launch and ongoing evolution.
Backlog Management: Prioritize and manage the backlog, balancing client-facing features, data quality, and platform investments in line with business goals.

Technical Requirement Definition: Write clear, detailed requirements and acceptance criteria, including data model changes, schema definitions, API contracts, validation rules, and data lineage expectations.

Private Funds Data Modeling: Define and evolve the domain data model, including GP/LP structures, master/feeder relationships, fund and asset taxonomies and sub-types, and the treatment of capital account and PCAP statements, capital call and distribution notices, and NAV and performance data.

Data Versioning & Integrity: Specify how data is versioned, corrected, and restated (e.g., immutable, transaction-based designs), and define approaches to entity matching, alias/deduplication, and reconciliation across sources.

AI & Automation: Shape and prioritize agentic and Generative AI capabilities, such as automated document procurement, extraction, classification, and validation. Define accuracy targets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, and evaluation methods.
Engineering Collaboration: Work daily with engineering on architecture trade-offs, feature design, and delivery, ensuring solutions meet client needs and scale with data volume and complexity.
Roadmap Creation: Develop and communicate the product roadmap, setting strategic direction for analytics, research and deal management, managed data services, and accounting capabilities.
Stakeholder Communication: Keep stakeholders informed on product updates, roadmap progress, and releases.
Client Engagement: Engage with Clients of Clearwater who maybe a GP, LP to understand their workflows and data needs, and translate them into actionable enhancements.
Operational Partnership: Work with data operations and service teams to measure and reduce manual intervention, turning root causes into product and automation improvements.

Senior Product Manager

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.
responsibilities: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

jobs.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

About Cloud Secure Edge

Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall’s cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform that provides enterprise-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN-as-a-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall’s SASE transformation.
responsibilities: We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will connect engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform’s evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.
Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy & Roadmap
Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall’s SASE and Zero Trust go-to-market objectives.
Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.

Drive integration strategy across SonicWall’s security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi-tenancy, scalability, and cloud-native deployment models.
Zero Trust & SASE Domain Leadership
Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
requirements: 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

jobs.description: The role At Axelerant, we believe the traditional handoff model , research to design to product to delivery , is no longer fit for purpose. AI tooling has collapsed the time between concept and working prototype, and the bottleneck has shifted from production to ownership. We are building for that reality. This is a new kind of role: the UX Product Owner, or UXPO. You are the single continuous thread connecting user intent to shipped value. You hold the story, the system, the design, and the sprint together , not as a coordinator, but as the person who owns all of it. You are not a designer
responsibilities: At Axelerant, we believe the traditional handoff model , research to design to product to delivery , is no longer fit for purpose. AI tooling has collapsed the time between concept and working prototype, and the bottleneck has shifted from production to ownership. We are building for that reality.

This is a new kind of role: the UX Product Owner, or UXPO. You are the single continuous thread connecting user intent to shipped value. You hold the story, the system, the design, and the sprint together , not as a coordinator, but as the person who owns all of it. You are not a designer who attends standups, and you are not a product owner who appreciates good UX. You are someone who does both, deeply, without losing fidelity in between.

The work lives in overlapping loops , plan, prototype, calibrate, validate, ship, measure , and discovery feeds the backlog on a weekly cadence, not once at project kickoff. You will use AI tools to compress the concept-to-tested loop significantly, while knowing precisely where human judgment is irreplaceable.
If you read a brief like this and think "that is already how I work," this seat is worth a conversation.
What you will own
Run end-to-end user research and translate insights directly into prioritized backlog items , no wall to throw them over
Own the product narrative from discovery through deployment, maintaining context and continuity across every loop
Design and iterate on systems thinking artifacts: user journeys, object models, and pattern libraries
Write clear acceptance criteria and work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers throughout the sprint
Build and test coded or high-fidelity prototypes rapidly using AI-assisted tooling
Manage and groom the product backlog, balancing user needs, business goals, and delivery constraints
Establish a continuous discovery rhythm so research informs the backlog weekly rather than at project kickoff
requirements: Proven experience spanning both UX design and product ownership , not adjacent exposure, but genuine depth in each
Strong research practice: you can design, conduct, and synthesize user research, then act on it without an intermediary
Fluency in systems-level thinking, including journey mapping, object modeling, and design system architecture
Comfortable and credible in agile delivery contexts , backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and direct collaboration with engineering teams
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping tools to accelerate the concept-to-tested loop
Ability to write precise acceptance criteria that bridge design intent and development implementation
Track record of maintaining product coherence across fast-moving, iterative delivery cycles
Clear communicator who can align stakeholders, advocate for users, and make prioritization trade-offs transparently
What you get
A role that is genuinely new , space to define and shape what great UXPO practice looks like
Collaborative, supportive team environment at Axelerant
Work at the frontier of AI-assisted product development with real ownership over outcomes

Products@DataWeave We, the Products team at DataWeave, build data products that deliver timely, actionable insights at scale. Our guiding principles are scale, impact, engagement, and visibility. jobs.description: Product Manager – Billing About the Role Delhivery moves millions of shipments every day, and every one of them has to be priced, invoiced, and collected correctly. A shipment billed late, billed wrong, or not billed at all is revenue the network earned but never banked. A disputed invoice also strains our relationship with a shipper. This role exists to fix that. As Product Manager for Billing, you will own the product strategy for Delhivery's contract-to-cash engine, from rate card setup and shipment pricing through invoicing, dispute resolution, and collections. You will build systems that
responsibilities: Delhivery moves millions of shipments every day, and every one of them has to be priced, invoiced, and collected correctly. A shipment billed late, billed wrong, or not billed at all is revenue the network earned but never banked. A disputed invoice also strains our relationship with a shipper. This role exists to fix that.

As Product Manager for Billing, you will own the product strategy for Delhivery's contract-to-cash engine, from rate card setup and shipment pricing through invoicing, dispute resolution, and collections. You will build systems that price every shipment accurately, catch revenue leakage before it reaches an invoice, and give shippers bills they trust. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role at the intersection of business, finance, operations, and technology.
What You Will Do

Own the roadmap, not just the backlog. Define the product strategy for billing accuracy, revenue assurance, and faster cash realization. Translate business objectives into a prioritized roadmap with crisp KPIs such as billing accuracy, dispute rate, invoice TAT, unbilled revenue, and DSO, and be accountable to them.

Go deep before you go wide. Conduct structured deep-dives across rate cards, contract terms, weight and dimension capture, surcharges, credit notes, and reconciliation to find where and why revenue leaks. Quantify the financial impact of every gap before proposing a fix.

Bridge business reality and product design. Spend time with finance, BD, key account managers, and shippers. Understand why invoices get disputed, why contracts are hard to configure, and where manual work creeps in. Bring that context back into product decisions.

Get the fundamentals right at scale. Build billing systems that handle Delhivery's breadth of businesses, including Express, PTL, FTL, and cross-border, along with complex commercial constructs like slab pricing, fuel-indexed surcharges, and minimum guarantees. Keep everything compliant with GST, e-invoicing, and audit requirements.

Drive execution without losing sight of the bigger picture. Work closely with engineering, QA, finance, and ops to ship scalable solutions on time. Facilitate trade-off conversations between technical feasibility, financial controls, and business urgency, and make the call.
Prioritize ruthlessly. Apply first-principles thinking to separate high-impact initiatives from noise. Keep the team focused on what moves revenue and cash.
requirements: 2+ years of product management experience in billing, fintech, ERP, logistics, or a fast-paced internet company

A solid grasp of billing and finance fundamentals, including rate cards, invoicing, accounts receivable, revenue recognition, and indirect tax (GST and e-invoicing), or the ability to get there quickly
Practical fluency with modern AI tooling: prompt engineering, RAG, and AI-assisted coding environments (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, KIRO)
Strong business instinct and comfort in a finance review, a shipper escalation, or a sprint review
A proven ability to own products end to end, from problem discovery through post-launch iteration
Hands-on SQL skills, so you can pull your own data, reconcile the numbers yourself, and let them challenge your assumptions
The ability to sit in an architecture review, understand the trade-offs being debated, and translate what matters to finance, BD, or leadership without losing fidelity in either direction
Why This Role

Billing is not a back-office function. It is where the value the network creates turns into revenue. Getting it right at Delhivery's scale takes systems thinking, financial rigor, and empathy for both shippers and internal teams in equal measure. If you want to build something that materially changes how a logistics business earns and collects, this is the seat.

jobs.title: Product Owner III
jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
responsibilities: PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against — keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort — the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market — with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.

As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. You'll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.

This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.
Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories
Help define and evolve requirements for MEM's publishing engine — how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
requirements: Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) — writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred
Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform
Comfort defining requirements for a 0-to-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows
Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering-ready PRDs
Familiarity with mobile-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus

Fluent with — or genuinely eager to learn — AI-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast-paced environment
2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms and vice versa
Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure
Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
preferred: Domain experience in Convenience Retail, ERP, Logistics, or Financial transaction processing solutions
Behavioral Competencies:
Ensures Accountability
Manages Complexity
Communicates Effectively
Balances Stakeholders
Collaborates Effectively

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

jobs.title: R-256479- Digital Product Manager (AI)
jobs.description:
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Digital Product Manager (AI) The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
responsibilities: We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.

This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.

Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.

Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.

Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.

Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.

Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.

Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.

Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management — Core Database Engine & AI
jobs.description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
responsibilities: In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for Teradata's core database engine: the massively parallel query engine behind every workload on the platform. You will shape the roadmap across the optimizer, execution runtime, workload management, and Global Planner, and own how the engine performs on native storage, cloud object storage, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.

This role sits at the intersection of the database engine and AI. AI agents are becoming the dominant consumers of enterprise data, issuing high volumes of exploratory, speculative queries, while GenAI and machine learning can improve the engine from the inside. Every core component needs to be rethought in this light, and you will lead that rethink and turn it into a roadmap engineering can build.

Two things anchor the role. Performance: you will spend significant time inside real workloads, query plans, and benchmarks, working with engineering to deliver measurable gains release after release. SQL: you will be the steward of Teradata SQL, the surface customers live in, making its syntax, semantics, and ergonomics simpler, more expressive, and safer for developers, analysts, and AI agents.
Strategy: Own the engine vision and multi-year roadmap, co-owning architecture direction with senior engineering leaders and making principled trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity.
AI and agents: Lead the rethink of every core engine component for AI agents as the new dominant workload, and apply GenAI and ML inside the engine to make it faster and more autonomous.

Optimizer, execution, and workload management: Agents send many redundant queries. Explore optimizing across queries, sharing intermediate results, and returning early or approximate answers. Apply learned cardinality and cost models and LLM-assisted rewrite, with guardrails that protect plan stability. Define how workload management absorbs bursty machine traffic through agent identity, priorities, and budgets.

Performance: Work hands-on with engineering on query plans, regressions, and bottlenecks. Own the benchmark suite and KPIs (latency, concurrency, plan stability, price-performance), including agentic workloads, and build regression gates into releases.

Open Table formats: Own the engine side of Iceberg and Delta Lake (scan planning, pruning, pushdown, write paths) so customers never trade performance for openness. Automate statistics, clustering, and compaction with AI.

SQL language and query interface: Design features that turn complex problems into simple, readable queries, reduce footguns while keeping power and backward compatibility, and stay aligned with ANSI SQL. Make the dialect something agents can safely generate and execute, and let agents steer with cost estimates, plan explanations, and hints.
Who You'll Work With

You will work with senior database engineering leaders, performance engineering, AI platform teams, the open table format product team, sales engineering, and executive leadership across the US, Europe, and India. This role starts as an individual contributor, leading through technical depth and influence and mentoring Staff-level PMs. It may grow into managing a team of product managers.
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
requirements: First-principles thinking and good taste: willingness to question long-standing database assumptions, a preference for elegance over verbosity, customer obsession, daily use of GenAI tools, and the credibility to earn the trust of senior engineers
The ability to read research critically, separate promise from hype, and design experiments to prove value, with a track record of setting multi-year platform strategy
A plus: experience designing SQL features or language extensions, hands-on work with optimizers or learned database components, open-source contributions, or publications at SIGMOD, VLDB, or CIDR
Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Product Manager, OXM

Location: India | Reports to: Head of OXM PBU | Experience: 5 to 11 years | Type: Full time

Summary

Anchanto is a leading global enterprise B2B SaaS provider delivering cloud-based solutions for brands, retailers, and logistics partners to streamline order, warehouse, inventory, marketplace, and omnichannel commerce management. The Operations Experience Management (OXM) system serves as a foundational product for 3PL, 4PL, 5PL, and distribution enterprises, enabling them to orchestrate orders across diverse channels and fulfillment centers while granting end-customers real-time operational visibility. This position is pivotal in shaping the OXM product trajectory, aligning technical execution with strategic business goals, market dynamics, and customer demands. The incumbent will assume full accountability for product definition, prioritization, and the delivery of high-quality releases, focusing on measurable outcomes rather than mere documentation. Operating under the strategic guidance of the Head of the OXM PBU, the role demands a leader who can steward the product with ownership, collaborate effectively within the leadership circle, and evolve established practices to meet the complexities of modern retail ecosystems.
responsibilities: Strategic Roadmap Definition: Formulate and drive the OXM roadmap by identifying capability gaps and prioritizing features based on customer needs, business objectives, and omnichannel retail challenges, balancing immediate delivery targets with long-term platform scalability.

Product Specification & Execution: Author comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria, ensuring functional and non-functional requirements regarding performance, security, and reliability are clearly defined for engineering teams.

Performance Measurement: Establish and track key success metrics, such as order processing rates and fulfillment SLAs, utilizing data analytics to identify performance gaps, prioritize improvements, and demonstrate the value of delivered features.

Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with senior leadership, engineering, operations, sales, and commercial teams to align on priorities, manage expectations, and resolve trade-offs, while engaging directly with customers and partners to understand evolving operational workflows.

Documentation & Knowledge Management: Oversee the creation and maintenance of accurate user guides, API documentation, technical specifications, and self-help resources to empower internal teams and customers to utilize the product independently.
Tooling & Governance: Manage product management ecosystems (e.g., Aha!, Jira, Confluence) to ensure transparency in planning, requirement traceability, and disciplined documentation practices.

Quality Assurance & Issue Resolution: Lead customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT) efforts, facilitate defect triage, and drive root cause analysis to prevent recurring issues and enhance overall release quality.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Support, Implementation, Marketing, and other Product Business Units (WMS, Integration, Parcel Tracking) to ensure seamless end-to-end consistency and successful product adoption.
requirements: Professional Experience: 5 to 11 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or domain-specific product roles, with a strong background in Order Management Systems (OMS), e-commerce, and 3PL/4PL/5PL logistics operations.
Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of 3PL, 4PL, and 5PL business models, including multi-client warehouse operations, multi-provider orchestration, and network-level data analytics.

Omnichannel Knowledge: Proven track record in managing product capabilities for omnichannel retail, covering order capture, allocation, store fulfillment, inventory visibility, and returns across marketplaces, webstores, and physical locations.

Technical Proficiency: Strong capability in writing detailed specifications, including PRDs and non-functional requirements, and the ability to collaborate closely with engineering on API integrations, business logic, and validation rules.

Analytical & Communication Skills: Excellent analytical thinking with proficiency in data analysis tools, paired with superior verbal and written communication skills to articulate vision and influence cross-functional teams.
Tool Mastery: Hands-on experience with industry-standard product management tools such as Aha!, Jira, and Confluence.
Leadership Mindset: Ability to thrive in a lean team environment, demonstrating strategic thinking, ownership of execution, and a passion for product innovation.
preferred: Qualifications: Additional experience in e-commerce technology, supply chain logistics, or B2B SaaS; familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns; and relevant certifications in Agile or Scrum methodologies.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI
jobs.description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
responsibilities: In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.
Who You Will Work With

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.
Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.
Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.
Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - IT Operations
jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
responsibilities: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead critical areas of IT Operations and Incident Management. You will identify the customer and business problems that make incidents difficult to detect, resolve, and learn from—and turn those insights into focused product strategy and execution.

This role will serve customers across both IT and Developer teams. You will work across the incident management journey, using a thoughtful combination of AI-powered and non-AI capabilities to improve customer outcomes, user experience, adoption, and business growth.
Define and execute product strategy for high-impact areas within Incident Management, impacting both IT and Developer personas
Identify customer pain points and business opportunities across Enterprise and SMB segments through customer research, product data, support insights, and market signals.
Prioritize opportunities that improve incident outcomes while creating meaningful value for customers and the business
Balance AI investments with reliable non-AI capabilities, including workflow improvements, automation, integrations, collaboration tools, reporting, and operational controls.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality experiences end to end.
Engage directly with Enterprise and SMB customers to validate problems, test concepts, understand adoption barriers, and measure impact.
Help JSM and Service Collection grow by increasing customer value, adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion within IT Operations.
Impact you’ll have
Better incident outcomes: Help customers reduce time to detect and resolve incidents.
Stronger cross-functional collaboration: Enable IT and Developer teams to work together effectively during high-pressure events.
requirements: 10+ years of experience building and launching successful B2B or SaaS products as a Product Manager or equivalent.
Strong customer empathy, for Enterprise and SMB, and a track record of turning complex customer problems into focused product strategies.
Comfort operating in technically complex spaces and partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science.
Practical understanding of AI-enabled product development, including when AI is appropriate and when deterministic experiences are better.
Strong analytical skills and a focus on measurable outcomes, experimentation, adoption, and business impact.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence across teams and at senior levels.
A bias toward action, strong product judgment, and the ability to make progress through ambiguity.
Success in this role

Success will mean building a clear, evidence-based strategy for specific areas within Incident Management; delivering experiences that customers trust during critical incidents; improving outcomes for both IT and Developer teams; and contributing to sustainable growth for the Service Collection.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a

Principal Product Manager

to lead our Factory Tech within our Sourcing team. Quince is building the operating system for the factories, mills, and vendors that make our products. Factory OS is the software our supply partners run their operations on - planning, scheduling, capacity, quality, and compliance - replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one system of record for how goods actually get made.

As Principal PM, you own this platform end to end: the vision, the roadmap, and the hard calls about what we build, for whom, and in what order. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with vendors and mills on the factory floor, and with our engineering, ops, and sourcing teams, to turn messy real-world production workflows into reliable software. This is a builders role with outsized scope - you're defining a category, not iterating on a mature one.
responsibilities: Own the Factory OS product strategy - from vendor/mill discovery through roadmap, specs, and launch - and be accountable for adoption and measurable operational impact (adoption, on-time production, capacity utilization, quality yield, planning accuracy).
Design the core operational workflows - production planning, scheduling, capacity management, order and material tracking - so they hold up under the reality of a working factory, not just a demo.

Build for compliance and auditability from day one. Factory data touches sourcing, labor, quality, and trade requirements. You'll make compliance, traceability, and auditability first-class product surfaces, not bolt-ons - and ensure the system produces the records our partners and Quince are held to.
Drive real adoption on the floor. A system that vendors and mills won't use is worthless. You'll obsess over onboarding, change management, and the gap between 'shipped' and 'used daily'

Set the AI and automation thesis. Architect Factory OS for a future where every automatable workflow is executed by an agent, not a person clicking through screens. Decide which steps to automate first, design the human-in-the-loop and exception paths, and treat agents, APIs, and humans as composable actors in auditable, business-grade workflows.
Partner deeply cross-functionally with engineering, ML, design, sourcing, and factory operations - translating ambiguous problem statements into shipped products.

Domain proximity to manufacturing, supply chain, or factory/operations software (MES/MOM, ERP, planning/scheduling, quality, or sourcing systems). You don't need to have run a factory, but you need to have built for people who do.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - myRico
jobs.description:
Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

Mission

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.
responsibilities: We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.
You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.
This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.
requirements: Customer obsession. You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.
Product judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.
A builder’s instinct. You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.
Technical fluency. You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.
Care for the details. You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.
Ownership. You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.
Clear communication. You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.
Experience

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.
Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

preferred: You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Global HealthX

Global HealthX is on a mission to reshape how people experience healthcare. We build products that

touch real patients and providers, in a market that is early, enormous, and moving fast. We are past the"will this work" stage and squarely in the "how big can this get" stage which means whoever joins

now gets to shape the product, the roadmap, and the culture while the story is still being written.

About Healix Engage

Healix Engage is our patient and provider engagement platform — the layer that turns healthcare

interactions into ongoing, meaningful relationships. It is a product with real users, real traction, and a

roadmap far larger than the team currently chasing it. There is white space here that most PMs only

dream about: core problems still to be solved, and the freedom to solve them well.
responsibilities: We are looking for a Product Manager to own Healix Engage end to end. This is not a backloggrooming, ticket-shuffling role. You will set direction, make the hard calls on what gets built and what does not, and be accountable for outcomes not just output. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and leadership, with unusual latitude to run experiments, kill bad ideas quickly, and double down on what is working.
If you have been the PM who quietly does the strategic thinking while someone senior takes the
meeting this is your chance to take the meeting.
Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Healix Engage, and translate it into a sequence of releases that compound.
Talk to users constantly patients, providers, internal teams and turn what you hear into sharp product decisions.
Define the problems worth solving, write crisp specs, and partner with engineering and design to ship fast without shipping sloppy.
Use data to decide. Set the metrics that matter, instrument them, and let the numbers not opinions settle debates.
Prioritize ruthlessly against limited time and resources the hallmark of a great PM at a growing company.
Be the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone aligned on the "why" and the "what's next."
requirements: Roughly 3–5 years in product management, ideally including time taking a product from early to scaling (0→1 or 1→10 experience is a big plus).
A track record of shipping products that moved real metrics you can point to specific outcomes you are proud of.
Strong product intuition paired with genuine comfort in data; you can zoom from strategy to a Figma detail to a SQL query and back.
Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and course-correct quickly.
Clear, persuasive communication you can align a room and write a spec that does not need a translator.
A builder's temperament: high ownership, low ego, and a bias for action. You would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for perfect.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Workday, Compensation & Advance Compensation
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Experienced Product Owner is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the Total Rewards: Compensation & Advance Compensation Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.

Key
responsibilities: Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery
Own your assigned Workday module(s): Compensation & Advance Compensation end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.

Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.
PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.
requirements: 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

DESCRIPTION

About Amazon Business:

Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.

At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.
responsibilities: Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.

The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.

We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:

1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.
2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
Outbound channels — email and push notifications
Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.
Key job responsibilities

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with end to end product delivery
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience as a product manager or owner
Experience owning technology products
preferred: Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

responsibilities: Senior Product Manager, Fleet Management Systems (FMS)
Location
BLR/GGN

Delhivery's freight network operates across thousands of vehicles, vendors, customers, and trips every day. Orion and our Fleet Management Systems sit at the center of this ecosystem—connecting demand creation, supply allocation, procurement, trip execution, tracking, documentation, and financial closure.

As Senior Product Manager for FMS, you will own products that make freight operations faster, more automated, and more efficient. You will work at the intersection of customers, operations, supply, engineering, data, and AI—simplifying complex workflows and progressively moving them from manual coordination to intelligent, system-driven execution.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complicated operational problems and turning them into scalable products.
What You Will Do

Own the roadmap, not just the backlog — Define product strategy and roadmap across freight and fleet workflows from demand/indent creation and supply-demand matching to trip execution, tracking, documentation, and closure. Define clear business and product KPIs and own outcomes.

Automate operations using AI — Identify workflows currently dependent on calls, emails, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or manual decision-making and redesign them using AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent recommendations.

Go deep into freight operations — Understand how customers raise demand, how supply teams source vehicles, how vendors bid and allocate capacity, and how trips are executed on ground. Spend time with operations, vendors, drivers, and customers to understand where systems diverge from reality.

Drive measurable operational outcomes — Use data to identify bottlenecks and measure improvements in metrics such as turnaround time, automation/adoption, vehicle placement, tracking compliance, vendor performance, and operational productivity.

Build for scale and reliability — Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to design systems that can handle complex workflows, integrations, real-time events, and large transaction volumes without creating operational fragility.
requirements: 4+ years of product management experience, preferably in logistics, supply chain, fleet management, marketplaces, B2B platforms, or a fast-paced internet company.
Strong product fundamentals with demonstrated ability to take ambiguous operational problems, structure them, quantify their impact, and translate them into scalable products.
Strong operational instinct—you are comfortable understanding workflows on the ground rather than designing products only from meeting rooms.
Hands-on SQL and data skills—you should be comfortable pulling and analysing your own data, building funnels, identifying failure patterns, and using data to challenge assumptions.
Practical fluency with modern AI tooling—LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, RAG, and AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar environments.

Strong systems thinking. You can reason across workflows involving customers, vendors, vehicles, drivers, payments, documents, APIs, and multiple internal systems rather than optimizing one screen in isolation.
Ability to influence across teams without relying on authority and to drive adoption after the product has shipped.
Why This Role

Freight operations have traditionally depended heavily on people coordinating through calls, messages, spreadsheets, and fragmented systems. At Delhivery's scale, the opportunity is to fundamentally change that.
FMS is evolving from a system that records freight operations into a platform that can increasingly understand demand, recommend decisions, automate coordination, and manage execution.
This role gives you the opportunity to build that transformation at scale—combining logistics, marketplaces, data, and AI to redefine how freight moves.

That's the layer this role owns. You'd spend your first months mostly listening: sitting in on support escalations and school onboarding calls, reading through user feedback, and starting to notice which small frictions actually cost renewals.

From there you'd move into writing lightweight specs for fixes and small features, working with a couple of engineers to get them built, and checking after launch whether they actually helped - not assuming they did because they shipped. jobs.title: Product Manager - Credit Data
jobs.description:
We are a seed-funded startup using state-of-the-art AI to reimagine how businesses access credit and risk intelligence. Our team includes ML and engineering talent from top-tier US tech companies, the product is live with early customers, and we're building fast. With our product already in the market, first clients onboarded, and sufficient runway secured, we are passionate about using AI to enhance access to credit information for businesses.

We're hiring a Product Manager
responsibilities: Credit Data Platform to own CredHive's proprietary B2B trade data network and the intelligence layer built on top of it. Think of this as building India's first contributed trade credit registry fused with company intelligence - where businesses report invoice and payment data, and the platform turns it into trade credit scores, buyer reliability signals, and supply-chain risk views that no public filing can provide. This is a high-ownership, 0→1 role where you'll design the data contribution flywheel, ship the scoring and intelligence products, and build the network effects that make CredHive's data moat permanently defensible.
Own the roadmap for the business intelligence data platform: contributed data ingestion, B2B trade credit scoring, supplier/buyer reliability profiles, and payment-behaviour analytics.
Design the data contribution flywheel: incentive architecture, value exchange mechanics, and cold-start sequencing to drive businesses to report trade receivables and payment data.
Build multi-channel ingestion paths — Tally plugin, Zoho/QuickBooks integrations, bulk Excel/CSV upload, WhatsApp-based invoice submission — prioritised by coverage and data quality tradeoffs.

Design trust and privacy layers: anonymisation of reporting relationships, DPDP-compliant consent flows, buyer notification mechanics, and confidence scoring that reflects reporting density and data freshness.
Own network health metrics: reporting density per buyer, geographic and sector coverage, reciprocity rates, data freshness SLAs — and use them to prioritise where to invest in growth next.
Drive cross-functional execution across Product, DS, Eng, Design, and GTM — with a particular focus on coordinating the two-sided nature of the product (contributors and consumers).
requirements: Prior ownership of a B2B product.
Strong grounding (2–3+ years) in one or more of: trade credit, B2B lending, supply-chain finance, SME credit risk, or procurement intelligence.
Experience with Indian SME ecosystems
Tally/Vyapar/Khatabook landscape, trade-association dynamics, regional industry clusters, and the realities of how MSMEs manage receivables and payables.
Has built or scaled a product where user-contributed data is the core asset - reporting platforms, review networks, credit registries, or B2B marketplaces.
Familiarity with Indian credit signals (ROC filings, GST compliance, bureau inputs, bank statement proxies, alternate data) and how they complement trade payment data.

As a Senior Product Manager of Managed Security Testing at VikingCloud, you will be responsible for the strategic planning, development, and execution of our offensive security testing services, including penetration testing as a service (PTaaS), vulnerability assessments, phishing simulations, social engineering testing, and specialized security assessments. You will own the product roadmap for VikingCloud's managed security testing portfolio, working closely with our internal security testing teams, third-party testing partners, and customers to deliver high-quality offensive security services that help merchants and financial institutions identify and remediate security weaknesses before attackers can exploit them. This role requires deep understanding of offensive security methodologies, industry certifications and frameworks (CREST, PTES, OWASP, PCI DSS ASV), and the ability to bridge technical security testing with compliance requirements. Define when to use internal testers versus third-party partners, automation versus manual testing, and on-demand versus scheduled assessments. Create standardized testing packages for common use cases while allowing customization for complex environments.

Vulnerability Management Integration: Integrate security testing services with VikingCloud's existing vulnerability scanning and management capabilities.
